subject: Acme demo — Hack Week conflict and options
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Soren Jorgensen <soren@acme.io>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro demo for Acme Payments — July 28

Hi Soren —

Looking forward to the demo next week (Jul 28, 10:00 PT). Quick heads up: our engineering org is running a company-wide "Hack Week" July 27–30. A few folks who would normally join the live deep-dive (model ops & QPS owner) will be on focused projects/off-calendar.

Options I want to propose so we keep momentum without compromising the experience:
- Option A: Move the live demo to Aug 4 (same time) so we have full engineering coverage.
- Option B: Keep the July 28 slot as a product-led run-through and provide an asynchronous recording + an optional live 30-min Q&A with an EM the following week.
- Option C: Transfer the live session to our EMEA teammate (Tessa) who can run an alternate slot for your APAC folks during the week — engineering depth will be lighter but we can bring in a recording for heavy technical questions.

I've attached the latest deck and a short screen-capture of the flow in case you want to circulate internally. If any of these work, tell me which you prefer and I'll lock the calendar. If you prefer, I can send the recording immediately and schedule the Q&A for a time that fits your procurement timeline.

Attachments: [Redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf (PDF, 3.2MB)], [async-demo-screencap.mp4 (MP4, 18MB)]

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Soren Jorgensen <soren@acme.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo for Acme Payments — July 28

Thanks Logan — appreciate the heads up. July 28 is tight for our execs (several traveling). Procurement wants to see something this week to keep the RFP moving, so Option B (async recording + short live Q&A) would work best for us. If you can send the recording by Tuesday (Jul 28) and we book a 30-min Q&A the following week that keeps things aligned with our timeline.

Two quick asks:
1) Can the recording include the end-to-end request/response latency numbers and a short note on dedicated vs shared routing?
2) Please include an abbreviated slide on compliance (data isolation, logging) — that's the procurement team's primary checklist item.

If you send the files, I'll loop in procurement and our engineering reviewer.

Best,
Soren Jorgensen
Director, Platform Strategy | Acme Payments
soren@acme.io

Looping in here to offer coverage options from EMEA if needed. Logan — happy to host a live follow-up Aug 3 / Aug 4 at 16:00 BST (morning PT) if Acme wants a European-friendly time. I can cover product flow and standard architecture questions; for deeper infra specifics we can either:
- include a short recorded segment from the eng owner (we can stitch it into the live session), or
- schedule a dedicated 30-min technical Q&A with an engineering owner after the main session.

I also dropped a Calendly link for quick scheduling: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30m

Ben — tagging for pricing note: if the RFP needs dedicated capacity benchmarks, we should be ready to provide the quantized profile and cost run-rate.

-Tessa
Solutions Lead, EMEA | Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Soren Jorgensen <soren@acme.io>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo for Acme Payments — July 28

Thanks Soren — we'll proceed with Option B. Plan below:

1) I'll send a recorded 18-min demo by end of day Tue, Jul 28 (will highlight latency, routing modes, and a compliance summary slide). Recording + deck will be uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/redwood/Acme-async-demo-0727
2) Tentative live Q&A (30 min) for Aug 11, 10:00 PT — please confirm that works for procurement + eng reviewer. If not, use the Calendly link Tessa shared to pick an alternate.
3) Ben: can you prepare the quantized cost profile and a one-page summary to attach to the Drive folder (label: ACME-54321-pricing.pdf)?

I'll send the recording and shared folder when the files are uploaded. Appreciate the fast turnaround from your side — this should keep the RFP on track without delaying engineering reviews.

Thanks —
